task_summary: 纠正上一轮自动直角接管的错误方向，修复纯图像方向外环在弯前偏差不变的问题；核对指定疯狂电路国二与海大源码，完成隔离候选和编译，不接车。
workflow_version: WORKFLOW_REVIEW.md + image-observation contract + source-reference audit + actual C regression + isolated ADS build

acceptance: 纯图像偏差产生转向需求，正常接口不能开启自动直角或路线。
同灰度输入复现旧窗口零偏差并验证新输出，当前候选范围回归通过。
真实C控制和目标编译与冻结源码绑定，明确未实车验证。
completed: 接回OUC前方爬线选点，输出右正像素，保持现有内环公式。
修正遮挡短直段误报有效居中，保留无效/保持/失线区分。
修正中断可打断日志字段采样的问题，使控制记录同一快照。
1044张灰度、14644次流水线调用，3521必需视觉检查及387控制检查通过。
ADS 0错13警告，HEX74917d55；原工程未改、未开串口、未烧录。
核对用户指定仓库的同源本地归档，不再误用另一国二参考。

metrics.name: Native contributors
metrics.basis: One source audit/review worker, one full-image testing worker; root implemented/integrated.

metrics.name: Target builds
metrics.basis: Initial candidate and final candidate after visibility/record fixes; final source hashes bound.

metrics.name: Post-initial candidate defects fixed
metrics.basis: Short occluded centered stub incorrectly valid; interrupt-interleaved record snapshot.

metrics.name: Prior-round scope correction
metrics.basis: Owner rejected automatic corner takeover; isolated prior candidate preserved, new candidate rebuilt from flashed lineage.

metrics.name: Optional diagnostic exceptions
metrics.basis: Nonactive fill2 interpolation/noise cases retained as failures; not counted in required pass total.

metrics.name: Hardware operations
metrics.basis: No serial, parameter writes, flashing or launch.

metrics.name: External model dispatch
metrics.basis: Native workers only; no Opus/DSH consultation.

metrics.name: Review/archive overhead
metrics.basis: Review overlapped work; remote archive verification follows measurement cutoff.

observations: Previous implementation solved an unwanted takeover behavior rather than the requested observation error; this round made the controller ownership contract explicit before editing.
Actual existing OUC target selector was bypassed by a fixed row-window adapter. Whole-frame tests reproduced the blind spot; changing Kp alone cannot supply missing image error.
Synthetic black occlusion exposed a near-zero valid fallback; a real-exit visibility gate fixed it but reduced gap tolerance, recorded rather than hidden.
Independent review found a nested-interrupt logging consistency issue; targeted source fix and final compilation closed it.
Two broad tool reads printed unnecessary full hash manifests; final freeze uses assertions and compact summaries instead.
The specified public source was already local. Origin, git blob and archive hashes verified provenance; failed webpage access was not called a current-remote verification.

recommendations.action: 先写清控制权归属：纯图像调参必须证明无角点元数据也能产生正确转向，有角点但零偏差不能自动转向。
recommendations.next_check: 后续实车同步图像、偏差、角速目标与有效年龄；不得用接管成功替代图像观测修复。

recommendations.action: 参考实现先核对分辨率、单位、符号、目标位置与输出接口；同为像素不代表相同增益工作点。
recommendations.next_check: 试车前恢复已存内环运行参数并单独调整外环；记录新观察模型。

recommendations.action: 将实际启用模式验收与额外模式诊断分开，保留所有失败和适用范围，禁止将可选失败静默删掉。
recommendations.next_check: 若以后打开虚线补线，必须重新通过该模式噪声与遮挡验收。

limits: 仅实线矩形调参候选；虚线、全元素、250高速和整圈未验收。
相机几何仍为继承模型，无实车新图像；源码结论与实车根因分开。
编译默认PID和风机不是最近临时实跑值，烧录后需恢复并回读。
没有同质量配对效率基线，不宣称速度或费用收益。
